title: Chat Loop Terminated
description: Emitted when the chat loop exits abnormally (hard circuit-breaker, idle timeout, max turns, hard ceiling, retry budget). Carries the structured reason so the FE can render a terminal pause card instead of truncating the assistant bubble.

iteration.description: Loop iteration at which termination occurred.

consecutive_failures.description: Number of consecutive tool failures at termination.

last_error.description: Last tool error message (if any), truncated for display.

last_tool.description: Name of the last tool whose failure contributed to termination.
